targets.rawSql:
SELECT gauge AS "Nodes"
FROM longhorn_node_count_total
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT sum(gauge) AS "Total Storage Capacity"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge
  FROM longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
) latest

SELECT sum(gauge) AS "Total Storage Usage"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge
  FROM longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
) latest

SELECT count(*) AS "Volumes Degraded/Faulted"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume) volume, state, gauge
  FROM longhorn_volume_robustness
  WHERE state IN ('degraded', 'faulted')
  ORDER BY volume, time DESC
) latest
WHERE gauge = 1

SELECT count(*) AS "Replicas Rebuilding"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (replica) replica, mode, gauge
  FROM longhorn_engine_replica_mode
  WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
  ORDER BY replica, time DESC
) latest
WHERE gauge = 1 AND mode = 'WO'

SELECT
  u.time,
  u.node AS metric,
  (u.gauge::float8 / NULLIF(c.gauge, 0)) * 100 AS value
FROM longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes u
JOIN longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes c
  ON c.node = u.node AND c.time = u.time
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.time) AND u.node IN ($node)
ORDER BY u.time

WITH capacity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge AS capacity_bytes
  FROM longhorn_node_storage_capacity_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
), usage AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge AS usage_bytes
  FROM longhorn_node_storage_usage_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
), reservation AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge AS reservation_bytes
  FROM longhorn_node_storage_reservation_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
), scheduled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge AS scheduled_bytes
  FROM longhorn_node_storage_scheduled_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
)
SELECT
  c.node AS "Node",
  c.capacity_bytes AS "Capacity",
  u.usage_bytes AS "Usage",
  r.reservation_bytes AS "Reserved",
  s.scheduled_bytes AS "Scheduled"
FROM capacity c
LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.node = c.node
LEFT JOIN reservation r ON r.node = c.node
LEFT JOIN scheduled s ON s.node = c.node
ORDER BY "Node"

WITH capacity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node, disk) node, disk, gauge AS capacity_bytes
  FROM longhorn_disk_capacity_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, disk, time DESC
), usage AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node, disk) node, disk, gauge AS usage_bytes
  FROM longhorn_disk_usage_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, disk, time DESC
), reservation AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node, disk) node, disk, gauge AS reservation_bytes
  FROM longhorn_disk_reservation_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, disk, time DESC
)
SELECT
  c.node AS "Node",
  c.disk AS "Disk",
  c.capacity_bytes AS "Capacity",
  u.usage_bytes AS "Usage",
  r.reservation_bytes AS "Reserved"
FROM capacity c
LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.node = c.node AND u.disk = c.disk
LEFT JOIN reservation r ON r.node = c.node AND r.disk = c.disk
ORDER BY "Node", "Disk"

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, node || ' — ' || condition AS metric, 'True' AS value
FROM longhorn_node_status
WHERE gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node || ' / ' || disk || ' — ' || condition AS metric, 'True' AS value
FROM longhorn_disk_status
WHERE gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  node AS "Node",
  disk AS "Disk",
  gauge AS "Healthy"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node, disk) node, disk, gauge
  FROM longhorn_disk_health
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, disk, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Node", "Disk"

SELECT
  node AS "Node",
  disk AS "Disk",
  attribute AS "Attribute",
  attribute_id AS "Attribute ID",
  gauge AS "Raw Value"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node, disk, attribute) node, disk, attribute, attribute_id, gauge
  FROM longhorn_disk_health_attribute_raw
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, disk, attribute, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Node", "Disk", "Attribute"

WITH cpu_capacity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge AS cpu_capacity
  FROM longhorn_node_cpu_capacity_millicpu
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
), cpu_usage AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge AS cpu_usage
  FROM longhorn_node_cpu_usage_millicpu
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
), mem_capacity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge AS mem_capacity
  FROM longhorn_node_memory_capacity_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
), mem_usage AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (node) node, gauge AS mem_usage
  FROM longhorn_node_memory_usage_bytes
  WHERE node IN ($node)
  ORDER BY node, time DESC
)
SELECT
  cc.node AS "Node",
  cc.cpu_capacity / 1000.0 AS "CPU Capacity (cores)",
  cu.cpu_usage / 1000.0 AS "CPU Usage (cores)",
  mc.mem_capacity AS "Memory Capacity",
  mu.mem_usage AS "Memory Usage"
FROM cpu_capacity cc
LEFT JOIN cpu_usage cu ON cu.node = cc.node
LEFT JOIN mem_capacity mc ON mc.node = cc.node
LEFT JOIN mem_usage mu ON mu.node = cc.node
ORDER BY "Node"

SELECT time, node || ' / ' || manager AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_manager_cpu_usage_millicpu
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node || ' / ' || manager AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_manager_memory_usage_bytes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node || ' / ' || instance_manager AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_instance_manager_cpu_usage_millicpu
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node || ' / ' || instance_manager AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_instance_manager_cpu_requests_millicpu
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node || ' / ' || instance_manager AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_instance_manager_memory_usage_bytes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, node || ' / ' || instance_manager AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_instance_manager_memory_requests_bytes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, pvc || ' read' AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_volume_read_iops
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pvc || ' write' AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_volume_write_iops
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pvc || ' read' AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_volume_read_latency
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pvc || ' write' AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_volume_write_latency
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pvc || ' read' AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_volume_read_throughput
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pvc || ' write' AS metric, gauge AS value
FROM longhorn_volume_write_throughput
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pvc || ' — ' || state AS metric, CASE WHEN gauge = 1 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS value
FROM longhorn_volume_robustness
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pvc || ' — ' || state AS metric, CASE WHEN gauge = 1 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS value
FROM longhorn_volume_state
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

WITH actual AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume) volume, pvc, pvc_namespace, gauge AS actual_bytes
  FROM longhorn_volume_actual_size_bytes
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY volume, time DESC
), capacity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume) volume, gauge AS capacity_bytes
  FROM longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY volume, time DESC
), encrypted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume) volume, gauge AS encrypted
  FROM longhorn_volume_encrypted
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY volume, time DESC
), last_backup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume) volume, gauge AS last_backup_epoch
  FROM longhorn_volume_last_backup_at
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY volume, time DESC
)
SELECT
  a.pvc AS "PVC",
  a.pvc_namespace AS "Namespace",
  round((a.actual_bytes::numeric / NULLIF(c.capacity_bytes, 0)::numeric) * 100, 1) AS "Used %",
  CASE WHEN e.encrypted = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Encrypted",
  round((extract(epoch FROM (now() - to_timestamp(lb.last_backup_epoch))) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Last Backup Age (hrs)"
FROM actual a
LEFT JOIN capacity c ON c.volume = a.volume
LEFT JOIN encrypted e ON e.volume = a.volume
LEFT JOIN last_backup lb ON lb.volume = a.volume
ORDER BY "PVC"

SELECT
  volume AS "Volume",
  snapshot AS "Snapshot",
  gauge AS "Actual Size",
  user_created AS "User Created"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume, snapshot) volume, snapshot, gauge, user_created
  FROM longhorn_snapshot_actual_size_bytes
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY volume, snapshot, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Actual Size" DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT time, replica || ' — ' || state AS metric, CASE WHEN gauge = 1 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS value
FROM longhorn_replica_state
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, engine || ' — ' || state AS metric, CASE WHEN gauge = 1 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS value
FROM longhorn_engine_state
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
ORDER BY time

WITH replicas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (replica) replica, volume, node, disk_path, data_engine
  FROM longhorn_replica_info
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY replica, time DESC
), engines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (engine) engine, image, frontend
  FROM longhorn_engine_info
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY engine, time DESC
), modes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (replica) replica, engine, mode
  FROM longhorn_engine_replica_mode
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY replica, time DESC
)
SELECT
  r.volume AS "Volume",
  r.replica AS "Replica",
  r.node AS "Node",
  r.disk_path AS "Disk Path",
  r.data_engine AS "Data Engine",
  m.mode AS "Mode",
  e.image AS "Engine Image",
  e.frontend AS "Frontend"
FROM replicas r
LEFT JOIN modes m ON m.replica = r.replica
LEFT JOIN engines e ON e.engine = m.engine
ORDER BY "Volume", "Replica"

-- gauge enum decoded per longhorn.io/docs/1.11.1/monitoring/metrics/
-- (0=New, 1=Pending, 2=InProgress, 3=Completed, 4=Error, 5=Unknown)
SELECT
  volume AS "Volume",
  backup AS "Backup",
  recurring_job AS "Recurring Job",
  CASE gauge
    WHEN 0 THEN 'New'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Pending'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'InProgress'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Completed'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Error'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Unknown'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS "State"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (backup) backup, volume, recurring_job, gauge
  FROM longhorn_backup_state
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY backup, time DESC
) latest
ORDER BY "Volume", "Backup"

WITH actual AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (backup) backup, volume, gauge AS actual_bytes
  FROM longhorn_backup_actual_size_bytes
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY backup, time DESC
), uploaded AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (backup) backup, gauge AS uploaded_bytes
  FROM longhorn_backup_uploaded_data_size_bytes
  WHERE volume IN ($volume)
  ORDER BY backup, time DESC
)
SELECT
  a.volume AS "Volume",
  a.backup AS "Backup",
  a.actual_bytes AS "Actual Size",
  u.uploaded_bytes AS "Uploaded Size"
FROM actual a
LEFT JOIN uploaded u ON u.backup = a.backup
ORDER BY "Volume", "Backup"

SELECT sum(gauge) AS "Backup Volume Backups"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (backup_volume) backup_volume, gauge
  FROM longhorn_backup_volume_backups_count
  ORDER BY backup_volume, time DESC
) latest

SELECT gauge AS "Backup Target Volumes"
FROM longhorn_backup_target_backup_volume_count
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) AS time, node AS metric, count(DISTINCT replica) AS value
FROM longhorn_replica_state
WHERE state = 'error' AND gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH volume_pvc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume) volume, pvc
  FROM longhorn_volume_robustness
  ORDER BY volume, time DESC
)
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', s.time) AS time, COALESCE(vp.pvc, s.volume) AS metric, count(DISTINCT s.replica) AS value
FROM longhorn_replica_state s
LEFT JOIN volume_pvc vp ON vp.volume = s.volume
WHERE s.state = 'error' AND s.gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(s.time) AND s.volume IN ($volume)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH replica_nodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (replica) replica, node
  FROM longhorn_replica_info
  ORDER BY replica, time DESC
)
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', m.time) AS time, rn.node AS metric, count(DISTINCT m.replica) AS value
FROM longhorn_engine_replica_mode m
JOIN replica_nodes rn ON rn.replica = m.replica
WHERE m.mode = 'WO' AND m.gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND rn.node IN ($node)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH volume_pvc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume) volume, pvc
  FROM longhorn_volume_robustness
  ORDER BY volume, time DESC
)
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', m.time) AS time, COALESCE(vp.pvc, m.volume) AS metric, count(DISTINCT m.replica) AS value
FROM longhorn_engine_replica_mode m
LEFT JOIN volume_pvc vp ON vp.volume = m.volume
WHERE m.mode = 'WO' AND m.gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND m.volume IN ($volume)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH errors AS (
  SELECT node, count(*) AS error_samples, count(DISTINCT replica) AS replicas_errored
  FROM longhorn_replica_state
  WHERE state = 'error' AND gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(time) AND node IN ($node)
  GROUP BY node
), rebuilds AS (
  SELECT rn.node, count(*) AS rebuild_samples, count(DISTINCT m.replica) AS replicas_rebuilt
  FROM longhorn_engine_replica_mode m
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (replica) replica, node
    FROM longhorn_replica_info
    ORDER BY replica, time DESC
  ) rn ON rn.replica = m.replica
  WHERE m.mode = 'WO' AND m.gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND rn.node IN ($node)
  GROUP BY rn.node
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(e.node, r.node) AS "Node",
  COALESCE(e.error_samples, 0) AS "Error Samples",
  COALESCE(e.replicas_errored, 0) AS "Replicas Errored",
  COALESCE(r.rebuild_samples, 0) AS "Rebuild Samples",
  COALESCE(r.replicas_rebuilt, 0) AS "Replicas Rebuilt"
FROM errors e
FULL OUTER JOIN rebuilds r ON r.node = e.node
ORDER BY "Error Samples" DESC, "Rebuild Samples" DESC

WITH volume_pvc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (volume) volume, pvc
  FROM longhorn_volume_robustness
  ORDER BY volume, time DESC
), errors AS (
  SELECT volume, count(*) AS error_samples, count(DISTINCT replica) AS replicas_errored
  FROM longhorn_replica_state
  WHERE state = 'error' AND gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
  GROUP BY volume
), rebuilds AS (
  SELECT volume, count(*) AS rebuild_samples, count(DISTINCT replica) AS replicas_rebuilt
  FROM longhorn_engine_replica_mode
  WHERE mode = 'WO' AND gauge = 1 AND $__timeFilter(time) AND volume IN ($volume)
  GROUP BY volume
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(vp.pvc, COALESCE(e.volume, r.volume)) AS "PVC",
  COALESCE(e.error_samples, 0) AS "Error Samples",
  COALESCE(e.replicas_errored, 0) AS "Replicas Errored",
  COALESCE(r.rebuild_samples, 0) AS "Rebuild Samples",
  COALESCE(r.replicas_rebuilt, 0) AS "Replicas Rebuilt"
FROM errors e
FULL OUTER JOIN rebuilds r ON r.volume = e.volume
LEFT JOIN volume_pvc vp ON vp.volume = COALESCE(e.volume, r.volume)
ORDER BY "Error Samples" DESC, "Rebuild Samples" DESC
